stories.title: SMU-FSU game to kick off at 9:15 p.m. ET with limited power
stories.summary: The game between No. 19 SMU and Florida State will kick off after a nearly two-hour delay and will be played with limited power at Doak Campbell Stadium.

stories.title: Judge, out since May 31, activated by Yankees
stories.summary: The New York Yankees activated three-time American League MVP Aaron Judge, 34, on Monday night, paving the way for his return against the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday after missing more than three months with a fractured rib.

stories.title: Giants cut Slayton, team's longest-tenured player
stories.summary: The Giants have released wide receiver Darius Slayton, moving on from their longest-tenured player.

stories.title: Manning eyes 2nd shot at OSU after 'rough' debut
stories.summary: Arch Manning says he doesn't like to think about his ill-fated debut against the Buckeyes last year as his Longhorns look for redemption this Saturday.

stories.title: Belichick: UNC focused on 'doing things properly'
stories.summary: Bill Belichick said Monday he believes UNC "totally" had an atmosphere of following rules amid a school investigation into conduct within his football program.
